title: Termination Lag: Coding Agents Solve Early but Stop Late
abstract: arXiv:2611.14960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents can solve a task well before they stop working on it. We characterize \emph{termination lag}--the number of steps between an agent's first correct patch and the end of its run--across five models, two agent frameworks, and three SWE-bench datasets by recording and testing every distinct repository patch generated during execution. Our analysis reveals that 38--82% of successful runs achieve a correct solution on their initial source-code edit. However, agents continue to expend substantial effort after correct patches, with post-solution steps accounting for a median of 35--37% for Qwen3-Coder and 54--60% for Laguna-XS.2 in successful runs on SWE-bench Verified and Multilingual. Agents spend most of these additional steps verifying their work and exploring the repository. In a small fraction of cases (1--8%), this continued activity leads agents to undo their earlier correct patch, leaving the final solution incorrect.

translated_title: 终止延迟：编码智能体很早解决问题却很晚才停止
translated_abstract: 编码智能体在停止工作之前很久就已经解决了任务。我们通过记录并测试执行过程中生成的每一个不同的代码库补丁，在五个模型、两个智能体框架和三个SWE-bench数据集上刻画了“终止延迟”的概念，即智能体首次生成正确补丁与其运行结束之间的步数。我们的分析显示，38%–82%的成功运行在最初的源代码编辑中就得到了正确解。然而，智能体在生成正确补丁之后仍继续消耗大量精力，在SWE-bench Verified和Multilingual数据集的成功运行中，解题后的步骤占中位数的35%–37%（Qwen3-Coder）和54%–60%（Laguna-XS.2）。智能体将这些额外步骤中的大部分用于验证自己的工作和探索代码库。在少数情况下（1%–8%），这种持续的活动会导致智能体撤销其先前的正确补丁，使最终解决方案变得不正确。
tldr: 该论文提出“终止延迟”概念，发现编码智能体在38%–82%的成功运行中首次代码编辑就已得到正确解，但之后仍花费35%–60%的中位数步骤继续验证和探索，甚至在1%–8%的情况下会撤销正确补丁导致最终答案错误。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "termination lag," revealing that coding agents solve tasks correctly on their first edit in 38–82% of successful runs yet continue spending a median of 35–60% of steps verifying and exploring afterward, occasionally undoing their correct patch (1–8% of cases) and ending with an incorrect solution.
